# Glaze SDK API Reference

The generated SDK reference is split into small files so agents can read precise sections without hitting file-size limits.

- Start here: [GLAZE-SDK-API-REFERENCE/INDEX.md](./GLAZE-SDK-API-REFERENCE/INDEX.md)
- Machine-readable lookup: [GLAZE-SDK-API-REFERENCE/symbols.json](./GLAZE-SDK-API-REFERENCE/symbols.json)
- Grep-friendly lookup: [GLAZE-SDK-API-REFERENCE/symbols.ndjson](./GLAZE-SDK-API-REFERENCE/symbols.ndjson)

Symbol keys are `window.glazeAPI.*` dotted paths for runtime APIs and `entrypoint#Export` for package exports
(e.g. `@glaze/core/backend#ipcMain`). Every entry also has a `name` field, so grep `"name":"ipcMain"` for
bare-name lookup.
For `window.glazeAPI.*`, check `defaultPreload`: `exposed` is callable in scaffolded renderer code, `partial`
requires checking child symbols, and `requires-wiring` needs a preload wrapper or backend IPC first.

Do not crawl `sdk/current`; use the generated index, symbol map, and exact reference files.
